description: Whether CGC can take a pre-booked pickup at a given date and time. Transfers run 24/7 by pre-booking except Christmas Day (25 December). Standard rates apply 6am–9pm AEST; pickups between 9pm and 6am carry an after-hours fee, shown in the quote before booking. Same-day requests should phone 0416 131 285. Christmas Day and the booking engine's blackout windows are closed (available:false with the closure message); some windows close only some vehicles. Travel within 12 hours needs direct contact.
